text:
lucy: noticed ~09:22 UTC some VPN users getting 403s when authenticating via SAML. Happening only from the corp-vpn subnet.

omar: I see a small spike in the sso-proxy error rate. Upstream idp (Okta) is rejecting client certs with 'unsupportedSignatureAlgorithm'.

trin: Any cert rotations or KMS ops around that time?

lucy: We rotated a KMS key for re-encrypting secrets at 09:20 but the plan was a blind rewrap. No scheduled proxy cert churn.

oncall-sre: Can someone pull the proxy logs and the secrets-service decrypt logs for 09:18-09:24?

omar: Grabbed logs. sso-proxy shows:

```
2026-03-20T09:22:13Z sso-proxy ERROR tls_client_cert verify failed: signature uses insecure algorithm
2026-03-20T09:22:13Z sso-proxy INFO upstream-request status=403 idp=okta-corp user=alexa vpn=true
```

secrets-bot: secrets-service events:

```
2026-03-20T09:20:02Z secrets-service INFO begin rewrap key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ks1/cryptoKeys/master-v2
2026-03-20T09:20:04Z secrets-service ERROR write: partial write detected, checksum mismatch for secret=ssoproxy-p12
2026-03-20T09:20:05Z secrets-service INFO write succeeded fallback to atomic tmpfile write
```

trin: Partial write + checksum mismatch = truncated secret observed briefly. If proxy fetched that it may have loaded malformed pkcs12 and OpenSSL picked a fallback key or parsed incorrectly, causing a weak signature algorithm to be used. That would explain Okta rejecting it.

lucy: Do we have evidence proxies fetched during the partial-write window? Which nodes restarted or reloaded credentials?

omar: I queried the nodes. Three pods in cluster sso-prod-1 had a config reload at 09:20:06 (k8s SIGUSR1 triggered by deploy watch). Those match the corp-vpn LB nodes with the failed sessions.

oncall-sre: Short mitigation: force certificate reload on affected pods (after ensuring secrets-service returns complete secret) and rotate the client cert with the IdP if needed. Also add a healthcheck to verify presented cert signature alg against policy.

trin: Quick check: pulled v1 (pre) and v2 (post-rotate) of ssoproxy-p12. v2 is now correct. v2 base64 decodes to a valid pkcs12, v1 matches too. vTMP (partial) base64 decodes but pkcs12 parse fails.

lucy: Rolling restarts queued for the three affected pods. I'll do a restart for node-sso-3 first and validate with a test login through corp-vpn.

(3m later)
omar: node-sso-3 restart complete, test login OK, no 403. Logs show secret fetch after restart returned full p12.

oncall-sre: Good. Next steps and postmortem items?

trin: Action items:
- secrets-team: enforce atomic renames for secret writes (write to temp-file then rename) and verify checksum before committing.
- deploy-team: prevent credential reload on SIGUSR1 during active rewrap windows, or add retry logic when parsed secrets fail validation.
- sso-proxy: startup cert validation must check signature algorithm and expiry; fail startup if cert wouldn't be accepted by IdP.
- infra: alert on secrets-service write checksum failures (threshold >0 triggers pager).

lucy: I'll open SEC-INC-2026-332 and attach the truncated blob, tcpdump of a failing handshake, and the write logs.

omar: FYI Okta team confirmed they don't accept SHA1 signatures anymore; they will not relax policy.

oncall-sre: Monitor for any other secret write anomalies for the next 2 hours. I'll keep an eye on the alert dashboard.

secrets-bot: Rewrap job completed: id=rewrap-2026-03-20T09:25Z status=clean

lucy: thanks everyone. Closing this thread; will link postmortem once SEC-INC-2026-332 is triaged.

okta-bot: Okta report attached: 3 failed handshakes from corp-vpn nodes between 09:22-09:23 UTC.

trin: adding note to runbook "ssoproxy cert lifecycle" about verifying secret integrity before reload.

lucy: ack, good catch.

oncall-sre: standing by until 11:30 UTC for regression window. Ping here if anything resurfaces.
